title.en: The Wise Parrot: the story in brief

text.en: A rich merchant keeps a talkative parrot in a golden cage, but the parrot longs for the open sky.

In a quiet village a rich merchant kept a bright, talkative parrot in a cage of gold. The parrot entertained him with stories and songs, but inside it longed for the sky and green trees.
Before a business trip the merchant asked what he could bring for his pet. The parrot said it wanted the joy of flying, and asked to be let free. The merchant loved it too much to let it go.
So the parrot asked him to give its friends in the jungle its greetings from the cage.
In a forest the merchant saw a flight of parrots of the same colour and gave the message. One parrot dropped from the tree like a stone.
Distressed, the merchant hurried away. At home he told his pet about the journey and the parrot that fell down in shock. At once his own parrot fell from the perch to the floor of the cage.
Thinking it had died, the merchant took the still warm body out and placed it on the windowsill. The parrot stirred, stretched its green wings and flew into the open sky, saying that its friend had shown it how to escape.

prompt.en: Retell how the parrot tricked the merchant.

points.en: It pretended to die and flew away.
